name: Paracetamol 500mg
commonUses: Temporary relief of mild to moderate pain (headache, toothache, muscle aches) and reduction of fever.
warnings: Educational reference only. Do not exceed recommended daily limits due to potential hepatotoxicity risks. Consult a doctor or pharmacist.
mechanismOfAction: Central inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis and modulation of hypothalamic thermoregulatory center.

name: Amoxicillin 500mg
commonUses: Treatment of susceptible bacterial infections such as acute otitis media, streptococcal pharyngitis, and respiratory tract infections.
warnings: Contraindicated in individuals with documented penicillin hypersensitivity. Complete full course as prescribed by a licensed physician.
mechanismOfAction: Binds to penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs), inhibiting bacterial cell wall peptidoglycan synthesis.

name: Ibuprofen 400mg
commonUses: Management of acute pain, swelling, and stiffness caused by arthritis, dental pain, and dysmenorrhea.
warnings: May increase risk of gastrointestinal ulceration or bleeding and cardiovascular thrombotic events. Take with food.
mechanismOfAction: Reversible inhibition of cyclooxygenase enzymes (COX-1 and COX-2) suppressing inflammatory prostaglandin synthesis.

name: Cetirizine 10mg
commonUses: Relief of symptoms associated with allergic rhinitis, perennial allergic rhinitis, and chronic idiopathic urticaria.
warnings: May produce mild somnolence in sensitive individuals. Exercise caution when operating machinery or driving.
mechanismOfAction: Selective peripheral histamine H1-receptor antagonist inhibiting histamine-mediated allergic reactions.

name: Omeprazole 20mg
commonUses: Treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis, and duodenal ulcers.
warnings: Prolonged unmonitored use may be associated with decreased magnesium and B12 absorption. Take on empty stomach 30 mins before breakfast.
mechanismOfAction: Suppresses gastric acid secretion through specific, irreversible inhibition of H+/K+ ATPase enzyme system in gastric parietal cells.

name: Metformin 500mg
commonUses: First-line oral monotherapy or combination therapy for glycemic control in adult Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
warnings: Risk of rare but serious lactic acidosis, particularly in patients with acute renal impairment or sepsis.
mechanismOfAction: Decreases hepatic glucose production, decreases intestinal absorption of glucose, and improves insulin sensitivity.

name: Atorvastatin 20mg
commonUses: Adjunct to diet to reduce elevated total cholesterol, LDL-C, and triglycerides in primary hyperlipidemia.
warnings: Patients should report unexplained muscle pain or tenderness (myopathy/rhabdomyolysis). Periodic liver enzyme monitoring recommended.
mechanismOfAction: Selective, competitive inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase.

name: Azithromycin 500mg
commonUses: Treatment of community-acquired pneumonia, acute bacterial exacerbations of COPD, and skin structure infections.
warnings: Potential prolongation of cardiac repolarization and QT interval. Use with caution in patients with proarrhythmic conditions.
mechanismOfAction: Binds to the 50S ribosomal subunit of susceptible microorganisms, interfering with microbial protein synthesis.
